entities.name: 5GS update status
entities.description: The 5GS update (5U) status pertaining to a specific subscriber, stored in non-volatile memory and updated during specific procedures.

entities.name: 5U1: UPDATED
entities.description: Indicates the last registration attempt was successful.

entities.name: 5U2: NOT UPDATED
entities.description: Indicates the last registration or service request attempt failed procedurally, e.g., no response or reject message was received from the AMF.

entities.name: 5U3: ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
entities.description: Indicates the last registration, service request, or registration for mobility or periodic registration update attempt was correctly performed, but the answer from the AMF was negative due to roaming or subscription restrictions.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: A procedure that updates the 5GS update status value upon execution.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: A procedure that updates the 5GS update status value upon execution.

entities.name: Network-initiated de-registration
entities.description: A procedure that updates the 5GS update status value upon execution.

entities.name: 5GS based primary authentication and key agreement
entities.description: A procedure that updates the 5GS update status value upon execution.

entities.name: Paging procedure
entities.description: A procedure that updates the 5GS update status value upon execution.

entities.name: Change in current TAI
entities.description: A condition where the current TAI does not belong to the current registration area while T3346 is running, which updates the 5GS update status.

entities.name: T3346
entities.description: A timer that, when running, affects the update of 5GS update status upon TAI change.

relations.description: Execution of registration procedure changes the 5GS update status value.
Execution of service request procedure changes the 5GS update status value.
Execution of network-initiated de-registration changes the 5GS update status value.
Execution of 5GS based primary authentication and key agreement changes the 5GS update status value.
Execution of paging procedure changes the 5GS update status value.
Change in current TAI which does not belong to the current registration area while T3346 is running changes the 5GS update status value.
TAI change condition is only applicable when T3346 is running.
5U1 is a possible value of the 5GS update status.
5U2 is a possible value of the 5GS update status.
5U3 is a possible value of the 5GS update status.
